architecture_decision.bootstrap: Use a Node-based npm package-runner as the one-shot normal-user bootstrap/update entrypoint; register an exact opencode-hi@VERSION in opencode.json; let OpenCode own registry package cache/materialization. Do not use project-root npm install, Git checkout, Bun wrapper, or persistent package materialization as the default path.
architecture_decision.model_inventory: Use OpenCode provider.list structured runtime inventory; intersect connected provider IDs when exposed; preserve exact host model capability metadata; apply Hi policy and role capability eligibility after host filtering. Do not scrape the full catalog and do not use the 0.2.1 opencode models --json fallback path.
architecture_decision.update: Reuse transactional registration ownership/rollback semantics; update only the exact Hi plugin spec and Hi-owned state; preserve user/foreign config.
architecture_decision.host_owned_state: Treat .opencode/node_modules and .opencode/.gitignore created by OpenCode as host-owned, not Hi-owned project state.
